title: Improving PM 2.5 prediction in New Delhi using a hybrid extreme learning machine coupled with snake optimization algorithm
summary: original publisher PDF verifies ELM-SO PM2.5 forecasts evaluated on held-out data against ML baselines; test performance is a concrete environmental prediction result.
ai_technology: ELM-SO: extreme learning machine with stochastic optimization

evidence.tested: The publisher PDF reports held-out PM2.5 forecasts and comparison with machine-learning baselines; the claim is limited to test-set predictive performance.
evidence.unknown: Held-out prediction does not establish real-world forecasting benefit under changing emissions and weather conditions.
evidence.ai_role: Uses ELM-SO to forecast PM2.5 concentrations and compares held-out predictions with machine-learning baselines.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
